name: AFAS Profit
description: AFAS Profit — Dutch ERP and HR: read any published GetConnector, list what is available, and inspect a connector's metadata. Token auth with AFAS's base64-wrapped XML token.
instructions:
**AFAS exposes nothing until somebody publishes a GetConnector.** That is the whole model, and it is why this adapter takes the connector name as a parameter rather than hard-coding entity paths.
1. In AFAS open **Algemeen → Beheer → App connector** and create an app connector for the integration.
2. Add the **GetConnectors** the agent should reach. The typed tools use the standard `Profit_Debtor`, `Profit_Debtor_Invoices` (outstanding debtor items) and `Profit_Employees`; anything else, including your own custom GetConnectors, goes through `afas_profit_get_data`. A GetConnector that has not been added to the app connector does not exist as far as the API is concerned.
3. Generate the **token**. AFAS gives you an XML blob like `<token><version>1</version><data>ABC123…</data></token>`. Base64-encode that entire string and put the result in `AFAS_TOKEN`. AFAS's own UI offers a base64 version — use it.
4. Set `AFAS_ENVIRONMENT` to the 5-digit environment number, e.g. `12345` (for environment `O12345AA` that is `12345`), not the full `O…` code. The adapter calls the production host `https://12345.rest.afas.online/ProfitRestServices`; for a test or acceptance environment change the base URL to `….resttest.afas.online` or `….restaccept.afas.online`.

**The Authorization header is `AfasToken <base64>`**, AFAS's own scheme.

**Filtering uses three parallel parameters.** `filterfieldids`, `filtervalues` and `operatortypes` are comma-separated lists read positionally: `filterfieldids=Nummer,Datum`, `filtervalues=1001,2026-01-01`, `operatortypes=1,4`. Operator 1 is equals, 2 is greater-or-equal, 3 is less-or-equal, 4 is greater, 5 is less, 6 is 'contains', 7 is not equal, 8 is 'is empty', 9 is 'is not empty', 10 is 'starts with', 11 'does not contain', 12 'does not start with', 13 'ends with', 14 'does not end with'. Operators 8 and 9 still need a (possibly empty) value. A comma between entries means AND; a semicolon starts an OR group. Getting the three lists out of step produces a wrong answer rather than an error.

**`skip` and `take` page**, default 0 and 100. Always pass `orderbyfieldids` when paging (AFAS calls it mandatory: without a sort the row order can change between calls). `skip=-1&take=-1` returns everything, which AFAS strongly discourages. The query string is limited to about 2,000 characters; past that AFAS answers 404.

**UpdateConnectors are deliberately not exposed.** They write into AFAS with the full force of the business logic behind them, and a malformed payload is not something to discover from an agent.

**Checked against AFAS's API documentation (docs.afas.help), not yet a live tenant.** Paths, query parameters, operator codes and the standard GetConnector names come from AFAS's published docs and OpenAPI files. A 404 on a typed tool usually means that GetConnector has not been added to the app connector; `afas_profit_list_connectors` shows what is.

tools.name: afas_profit_list_connectors
tools.description: List the GetConnectors and UpdateConnectors published to this app connector. Start here: anything not in this list does not exist as far as the API is concerned.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_connector_metadata
tools.description: Read one GetConnector's field definitions: the field ids, their types and lengths. You need the field ids before any filter will work.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_data
tools.description: Read rows from a GetConnector with AFAS's positional three-list filter. filterfieldids, filtervalues and operatortypes are read in parallel — keep them in step.

connectorName.description: GetConnector name as listed by afas_profit_list_connectors, e.g. Profit_Debtor_Invoices or your own custom connector.

filterfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to filter on, e.g. DebtorId,ExpDate (take them from afas_profit_get_connector_metadata).

filtervalues.description: Comma-separated values, positionally matched to filterfieldids.

operatortypes.description: Comma-separated operator codes, positionally matched to filterfieldids (use `;` instead of `,` between groups for OR). 1 =, 2 >=, 3 <=, 4 >, 5 <, 6 contains, 7 not equal, 8 is empty, 9 is not empty, 10 starts with, 11 does not contain, 12 does not start with, 13 ends with, 14 does not end with. Operators 8 and 9 still need a (possibly empty) value in filtervalues.

skip.description: Rows to skip, for paging (default 0). Always combine with orderbyfieldids so pages do not overlap.

take.description: Rows to return (AFAS default 100). Keep it modest; skip=-1 together with take=-1 returns everything, which AFAS strongly discourages.

orderbyfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to sort by; prefix with `-` for descending. AFAS requires a sort whenever you page with skip/take, otherwise rows can repeat or go missing between pages.
